justification: Adds a whole-lot test to the flood planning answer for callers holding the lot outline. Not Critical: only replaces a point-distance guess with a lot test, untrusted outlines ignored. Not Minor: served flood answers in the brief and paid report change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a clear whole lot is not a no, a lot hit is not a yes, or an untrusted outline is used for a no.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Same trusted-boundary rule as lib/flood/flood-map.ts (Sol review 2026-10-20).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The three new tests describe behaviour absent before (no lot_wkt parameter existed).

pre_impl.existing_data: spatial_overlays flood: 33 values, 72 councils; spatial_overlays_coverage says 12 (stale, not used).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old lookup said False whenever the table had any flood row, and True for PMF and non-flood rows.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new producer module; the flood tool's own flood queries removed (producer lint 4->2 in flood_truth).
pre_impl.external_source_error: Spatial Services outage or DB error -> None with reason, never no.

functions.name: flood_planning_status
functions.input: lat, lng, a DB connection and an optional lot outline
functions.output: dict with value, reason, whole_lot flag
functions.if_none: No outline keeps the point rule unchanged.
functions.edge_cases: outline invalid or not at the address
functions.failure_mode: Falls back to the point rule, never a stronger no

functions.name: _trusted_lot
functions.what: Uses the outline only if valid and at the address.
functions.output: the same outline, or None when it is not used
functions.if_none: Any error returns None (outline not used).

break_it.scenario: Large lot partly on the map with the address point off it
break_it.what_happens: The lot test finds the hit and answers yes

break_it.scenario: Outline is a neighbouring lot's boundary
break_it.what_happens: Ignored; point rule applies, never a whole-lot no

break_it.scenario: Whole lot clear in a council whose map we hold
break_it.what_happens: Real no worded as no part of the lot
break_it.how: lot path before the 200 m rule

gaps: Flood tool and verify app do not pass a lot outline (verify keeps its layer-230 whole-lot test)

post_merge.action: After deploy: brief for one held-council address shows 'no part of the lot' wording
post_merge.manual_verify: Conveyancing PDF flood row for a large partly-flooded lot reads yes
